body:
Implements ADR-018 (docs/decisions/018-pseudo-classes.md).

## Summary

Add three state pseudo-classes -- :link, :visited, :hover -- with state tracked outside the DOM. Before this, every a renders identically; Firefox and Chrome have shipped visited-link purple and hover feedback since the mid-1990s.

Architectural separation: RenderState (mutable, owned by RenderPipeline) holds visited_urls + hovered_element. dom::Element stays immutable per ADR-007.

## Scope -- 5 commits

### Commit 1: RenderState + cascade overload (no behavior change)

- New struct RenderState { unordered_set<string> visited_urls; const dom::Element* hovered_element; float pointer_x, pointer_y; } in css/cascade.hpp.
- cascade(ua, author, doc) gains an overload cascade(ua, author, doc, state). Old signature delegates with default RenderState{}.
- Selector::matches(node) gains overload matches(node, state). Old delegates.

### Commit 2: Parser + specificity

- SimpleKind gains PseudoLink, PseudoVisited, PseudoHover.
- Parser recognizes :link, :visited, :hover after compound selector.
- Other pseudo-classes are parse errors (strict parser policy).
- Specificity: each pseudo-class counts as class (weight b), per CSS 2.1 section 6.4.3.
- Matching: :link = a[href] not in visited_urls; :visited = a[href] in visited_urls; :hover = node == hovered_element OR ancestor of hovered_element.

### Commit 3: UA stylesheet rules

- a:link { color: #0000EE }
- a:visited { color: #551A8B }
- a:hover { color: #0055EE }
- Rule count 15 -> 17 (replacing a { color: #0000EE } with the three pseudo rules).

### Commit 4: RenderPipeline + window.cpp mouse wiring

- RenderPipeline gains RenderState state_ member.
- set_hovered_element(const dom::Element*) triggers cascade relayout + repaint on change.
- record_visit(const std::string& url) adds to visited_urls and triggers recompute.
- window.cpp: Gtk::EventControllerMotion on DrawingArea; on motion, hit-test layout tree to find deepest Element under cursor, call set_hovered_element. On motion leave, set nullptr.
- On successful fetch, call record_visit(final_url).

### Commit 5: Docs refresh

- current-state.md: :link, :visited, :hover added to "renders correctly". Privacy note for :visited added.
- README: pseudo-classes row (partial: only :link, :visited, :hover).
- decisions/README.md: ADR-018 in index, reading order updated.

## Behavior (before / after)

a[href] not visited
  Before: blue (#0000EE from a rule)
  After: blue (#0000EE from a:link)

a[href] visited
  Before: blue
  After: purple (#551A8B)

a[href] hovered
  Before: blue
  After: lighter blue (#0055EE)

a (no href)
  Before: blue
  After: inherits body color (no :link match)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] RenderState struct in cascade.hpp
- [ ] cascade(ua, author, doc, state) overload compiles; old overload delegates
- [ ] Selector::matches(node, state) overload; old delegates
- [ ] Parser recognizes :link, :visited, :hover
- [ ] Other pseudo-classes return nullopt
- [ ] Specificity correct for each pseudo-class
- [ ] :link matches unvisited a[href]
- [ ] :visited matches visited a[href]
- [ ] :hover matches hovered element and its ancestors
- [ ] UA stylesheet has 3 rules replacing the single a rule
- [ ] RenderPipeline::set_hovered_element triggers relayout
- [ ] RenderPipeline::record_visit adds to visited_urls
- [ ] window.cpp installs EventControllerMotion
- [ ] All existing 217 tests pass
- [ ] New tests: 6+ selectors, 3+ cascade, ua count updated, 2 pipeline
- [ ] grep -rl "lexbor/" src/ returns only src/renderer/html/convert.cpp
- [ ] CI green

## Privacy limitation (documented)

v1 does not partition :visited state per-page. A page can detect visited URLs by rendering links and measuring their color. Deferred to a future privacy ADR. Documented in current-state.md.

## Refs

- ADR-018: docs/decisions/018-pseudo-classes.md
- ADR-008: docs/decisions/008-css-selectors.md
- ADR-010: docs/decisions/010-cascade.md
title: [Help Wanted]: Implement state pseudo-classes per ADR-018
